Amrit ​​gathaen: tulsidas ji ki bhakti se kaise huee hanuman chalisa ki rachna?
Jab samrat akbar ne unki bhakti ka praman manga, to tulsidas ji ke inkar karne par unhen karagar men dal diya gaya. kaid men rahne ke bavjud, bhagvan ram ke prati unki aastha adig rahi, jisse bhakti aur eeshvariy kripa ki ek adbhut gatha samne aaee. is divali, 'amrit gathaen' men hanuman chalisa ki rachna ke pichhe ki dilchasp kahani janie.
How did Goswami Tulsidas Ji’s unwavering devotion lead to the creation of the sacred Hanuman Chalisa?
